---
title: "`ev_read_contrasts()` — per-contrast CSVs into one long table"
---

## Purpose

Read a folder (or list) of per-contrast CSV files into a single validated long
tibble, using each file name as the contrast label.

## When to use

When contrasts live in separate files — one CSV per comparison — and you want
them stacked, canonicalised, and UniProt-mapped in a single call before feeding
`enrich_volcano()`.

## How it works

- Resolves `path`: a directory is globbed with `pattern`; otherwise `path` is
  treated as an explicit vector of file paths.
- The file name without extension becomes the `contrast` label; duplicate
  labels abort.
- Each CSV is read (`check.names = FALSE`), tagged with its contrast, and
  row-bound.
- If `padj` names an existing adjusted-p column it is renamed to `adj.P.Val`.
- The combined frame is handed to **`ev_validate()`**, which auto-detects the
  format and canonicalises columns plus UniProt→symbol mapping.
- When no `adj.P.Val` column is present, **`adjust_p()`** computes it with
  `p_adjust`. Because `adjust_p()` strips custom attributes, the
  `ev_idmap_report` attribute is stashed and restored so
  `ev_idmap_report()` still works downstream.

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `species` | *(required)* | UniProt mapping species (`human`/`mouse`/`rat`) |
| `p_adjust` | `"BH"` | FDR method when no adjusted column exists |
| `uniprot`, `x`, `y` | `NULL` | column overrides forwarded to `ev_validate()` |
| `padj` | `NULL` | name of an existing adjusted-p column to reuse |
| `pattern` | `"\\.csv$"` | file-matching regex when `path` is a directory |

## Literature

No method-specific citation; see [methods](../methods.qmd).

## Example

```r
res <- ev_read_contrasts("results/contrasts/", species = "rat")
unique(res$contrast)        # one label per CSV file
ev_idmap_report(res)        # mapping summary survives the read
```
